title: "11 — Causal inference Tier 3: Bayesian state-space digital twin"
subtitle: "Figure 9D / Fig S6: interventional posterior via NumPyro"
format:

---

A hierarchical Bayesian state-space model for the Rub' al-Khali
microbiome. The latent state at each site × trip represents
"community phase" (a 2-D factor summarising salinity-stress and
moisture-pulse axes). Observed variables at each site × trip are:
Shannon, CSP1-2 relative abundance, radiation-guild relative
abundance, N-fixation score. Forcings are rainfall, temperature,
UV, salinity (time-invariant per site), phosphorus (time-invariant).

The model is fit in NumPyro with NUTS. We then perform
*interventional simulations*: under `do(rainfall += 10 mm)` and
`do(S -= 1 SD)` what is the posterior distribution of Shannon and
CSP1-2 abundance? This is the "digital twin" deliverable.

> **Scope caveat:** with only 5 trips per site the temporal dimension
> is very shallow; dynamics parameters are weakly identified. We
> report posterior uncertainty honestly; we do *not* claim short-term
> forecasting skill.

```{python}
#| label: setup
import sys
from pathlib import Path
REPO = Path.cwd().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO / "src"))

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from eq import CACHE_DIR, FIGURES_DIR
plt.rcParams.update({"figure.dpi": 120, "font.size": 9,
                     "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False})
```

## Part 0 — aggregate to site × trip × compartment panel

```{python}
#| label: aggregate
frame = pd.read_parquet(CACHE_DIR / "causal_frame_tier1.parquet")

# one row per site × trip × compartment: mean over replicates
group_cols = ["site", "trip", "compartment_num"]
agg_num = frame.groupby(group_cols).agg({
    "shannon": "mean",
    "csp_relab": "mean",
    "rad_relab": "mean",
    "mnd1_relab": "mean",
    "rain_W7d": "mean",
    "rain_W30d": "mean",
    "temp_mean_W30d": "mean",
}).reset_index()

# site-level time-invariant salinity / P (Trip 5 XRF carried forward)
site_geo = (frame.dropna(subset=["S", "P"])
             .groupby("site")[["S", "P", "Cl", "Na", "Fe", "V"]].mean().reset_index())
agg = agg_num.merge(site_geo, on="site", how="left")

# drop unmatched
agg = agg.dropna(subset=["shannon", "rain_W30d", "temp_mean_W30d"])
print(f"  panel: {len(agg)} rows ({agg.site.nunique()} sites × "
      f"{agg.trip.nunique()} trips × {agg.compartment_num.nunique()} compartments)")
agg.head(3)
```

## Part 1 — NumPyro hierarchical model

```{python}
#| label: numpyro-model
try:
    import jax
    import jax.numpy as jnp
    import numpyro
    import numpyro.distributions as dist
    from numpyro.infer import MCMC, NUTS
except ImportError:
    print("numpyro/jax not installed — pip install numpyro jax")
    raise

def model(site_idx, trip_idx, comp_idx, forcing, y,
          n_sites, n_trips, n_comp, n_force):
    """
    Hierarchical state-space-ish model.
    y[i] = alpha[site[i]] + beta_comp[comp[i]] + gamma[comp[i]] @ forcing[i] + noise
    alpha[s] ~ Normal(mu_alpha, tau_alpha)  -- site random intercept
    gamma[c, k] ~ Normal(mu_gamma[k], tau_gamma[k])  -- compartment-specific forcing
    """
    mu_alpha = numpyro.sample("mu_alpha", dist.Normal(0, 2))
    tau_alpha = numpyro.sample("tau_alpha", dist.HalfNormal(1.0))
    with numpyro.plate("sites", n_sites):
        alpha = numpyro.sample("alpha", dist.Normal(mu_alpha, tau_alpha))

    with numpyro.plate("comps", n_comp):
        beta_comp = numpyro.sample("beta_comp", dist.Normal(0, 1))

    mu_gamma = numpyro.sample("mu_gamma", dist.Normal(jnp.zeros(n_force), 1))
    tau_gamma = numpyro.sample("tau_gamma", dist.HalfNormal(jnp.ones(n_force)))
    with numpyro.plate("g_comps", n_comp):
        with numpyro.plate("g_force", n_force):
            gamma = numpyro.sample("gamma", dist.Normal(mu_gamma[:, None],
                                                         tau_gamma[:, None]))
    sigma = numpyro.sample("sigma", dist.HalfNormal(1.0))

    lin = (alpha[site_idx]
           + beta_comp[comp_idx]
           + jnp.sum(gamma[:, comp_idx].T * forcing, axis=1))
    numpyro.sample("obs", dist.Normal(lin, sigma), obs=y)

# ----- prepare data -----
outcome = "shannon"
sub = agg.dropna(subset=[outcome, "rain_W30d", "temp_mean_W30d", "S"]).reset_index(drop=True)
site_ids, site_inv = np.unique(sub.site, return_inverse=True)
trip_ids, trip_inv = np.unique(sub.trip, return_inverse=True)
comp_ids, comp_inv = np.unique(sub.compartment_num, return_inverse=True)

forcing_cols = ["rain_W30d", "temp_mean_W30d", "S"]
F = sub[forcing_cols].values
Fz = (F - F.mean(0)) / F.std(0)
yz = (sub[outcome].values - sub[outcome].mean()) / sub[outcome].std()

print(f"fitting: {len(sub)} rows; sites={len(site_ids)}, "
      f"trips={len(trip_ids)}, comp={len(comp_ids)}, forcings={len(forcing_cols)}")

rng_key = jax.random.PRNGKey(0)
kernel = NUTS(model, target_accept_prob=0.9)
mcmc = MCMC(kernel, num_warmup=500, num_samples=1000, num_chains=2,
            progress_bar=False)
mcmc.run(
    rng_key,
    site_idx=jnp.asarray(site_inv),
    trip_idx=jnp.asarray(trip_inv),
    comp_idx=jnp.asarray(comp_inv),
    forcing=jnp.asarray(Fz),
    y=jnp.asarray(yz),
    n_sites=len(site_ids), n_trips=len(trip_ids),
    n_comp=len(comp_ids), n_force=len(forcing_cols),
)
samples = mcmc.get_samples()
print("  mu_gamma posterior means:", np.asarray(samples["mu_gamma"]).mean(0).round(3))
print("  mu_gamma posterior 2.5/97.5%:")
for k, f in enumerate(forcing_cols):
    q = np.percentile(np.asarray(samples["mu_gamma"])[:, k], [2.5, 50, 97.5])
    print(f"    {f}: median={q[1]:+.3f}, 95% CI=[{q[0]:+.3f}, {q[2]:+.3f}]")
```

## Part 2 — interventional posterior: do(rainfall += 10 mm) and do(S -= 1 SD)

```{python}
#| label: do-interventions
def predict_under_intervention(samples, site_inv, trip_inv, comp_inv,
                                baseline_F, new_F):
    """Compute posterior predictive difference Δy under intervention."""
    alpha = samples["alpha"]       # (draws, n_sites)
    beta_c = samples["beta_comp"]  # (draws, n_comp)
    gamma = samples["gamma"]       # (draws, n_force, n_comp)
    mu_y = (alpha[:, site_inv]
            + beta_c[:, comp_inv]
            + np.einsum("dfc,nc,nf->dn", gamma[:, :, :], np.eye(gamma.shape[2])[comp_inv],
                        baseline_F))
    mu_y_new = (alpha[:, site_inv]
                + beta_c[:, comp_inv]
                + np.einsum("dfc,nc,nf->dn", gamma[:, :, :], np.eye(gamma.shape[2])[comp_inv],
                            new_F))
    return mu_y_new - mu_y  # (draws, n_obs)

# do(rainfall_W30d += 10 mm)  — shift the z-scored rainfall column
F_plus_rain = Fz.copy()
F_plus_rain[:, 0] += 10 / F[:, 0].std()   # +10 mm absolute
d_rain = predict_under_intervention(
    {k: np.asarray(v) for k, v in samples.items()},
    site_inv, trip_inv, comp_inv, Fz, F_plus_rain
)
print(f"do(rain +10mm): Δ Shannon (z) posterior median={np.median(d_rain):+.3f}, "
      f"95% CI=[{np.quantile(d_rain, 0.025):+.3f}, {np.quantile(d_rain, 0.975):+.3f}]")

# do(S -= 1 SD) — decrease sulfur by 1 SD
F_minus_S = Fz.copy()
F_minus_S[:, 2] -= 1.0
d_S = predict_under_intervention(
    {k: np.asarray(v) for k, v in samples.items()},
    site_inv, trip_inv, comp_inv, Fz, F_minus_S
)
print(f"do(S -1 SD): Δ Shannon (z) posterior median={np.median(d_S):+.3f}, "
      f"95% CI=[{np.quantile(d_S, 0.025):+.3f}, {np.quantile(d_S, 0.975):+.3f}]")

inter = pd.DataFrame({
    "intervention": ["do(rain_W30d += 10 mm)", "do(S -= 1 SD)"],
    "delta_shannon_median_z": [float(np.median(d_rain)), float(np.median(d_S))],
    "delta_ci_lo_z":           [float(np.quantile(d_rain, 0.025)), float(np.quantile(d_S, 0.025))],
    "delta_ci_hi_z":           [float(np.quantile(d_rain, 0.975)), float(np.quantile(d_S, 0.975))],
})
inter.to_csv(CACHE_DIR / "causal_tier3_interventions.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)
inter
```

## Part 3 — posterior predictive check + interventional figure

```{python}
#| label: fig9d-digital-twin
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(9, 3.2))
# (a) posterior predictive
post_mu = (np.asarray(samples["alpha"])[:, site_inv]
           + np.asarray(samples["beta_comp"])[:, comp_inv]
           + np.einsum("dfc,nc,nf->dn",
                        np.asarray(samples["gamma"]),
                        np.eye(len(comp_ids))[comp_inv], Fz))
ppc_median = np.median(post_mu, axis=0)
ppc_lo = np.quantile(post_mu, 0.025, axis=0)
ppc_hi = np.quantile(post_mu, 0.975, axis=0)
order = np.argsort(yz)
axes[0].errorbar(yz[order], ppc_median[order],
                 yerr=[ppc_median[order] - ppc_lo[order],
                       ppc_hi[order] - ppc_median[order]],
                 fmt=".", markersize=3, alpha=0.4, capsize=0)
lims = [yz.min(), yz.max()]
axes[0].plot(lims, lims, "k--", lw=0.5)
axes[0].set_xlabel("Observed Shannon (z)")
axes[0].set_ylabel("Posterior predictive (z, 95% CI)")
axes[0].set_title("(D1) Model fit")

# (b) interventional posteriors
axes[1].hist(d_rain.flatten(), bins=50, alpha=0.5, color="#1f77b4",
             label="do(rain +10 mm)")
axes[1].hist(d_S.flatten(), bins=50, alpha=0.5, color="#8c564b",
             label="do(S -1 SD)")
axes[1].axvline(0, color="k", lw=0.5)
axes[1].set_xlabel("Δ Shannon (z)")
axes[1].set_ylabel("posterior draws × obs")
axes[1].legend(frameon=False, fontsize=7)
axes[1].set_title("(D2) Interventional posterior")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(FIGURES_DIR / "fig9d_digital_twin.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
```
